correctness.rationale: On the generic complex rank-two Hankel recurrence with a0=1,a1=b,a4=c, the intermediate curve is P²-(S²+2bS)P+bS³-c=0 and Y²=S⁴+4b²S²+4c, a smooth genus-one double cover when b,c,c-b⁴ are nonzero. The affine recurrence parameters are birational on the generic rank-two locus. At the two points above infinity, a_{4+k} has pole orders k+4 (or k+3 if 3 divides k) and k; the drop comes from a simple zero in the Lucas recurrence h_k(1). There are no other poles as all moments are polynomials in the recurrence parameters on the affine curve. Degree of the finite rational function is total polar order. Thus for every n>=6 degree is 2n-7 when n=2 mod 3, 2n-6 otherwise. Independent SymPy eliminants at generic specializations n=6..9 recovered the formula; these finite checks only corroborate the valuation proof.
